items.translation: `org.springframework.orm.jpa` 中 `PersistenceUnitPostProcessor` 的用法
`PersistenceUnitPostProcessor` 接口在 `org.springframework.orm.jpa.persistenceunit` 包中的用法

items.source: Package providing integration of JPA (Java Persistence API) with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 提供将 JPA（Java 持久化 API）与 Spring 概念集成的包。

items.source: Internal support for managing JPA persistence units.
items.translation: 用于管理 JPA 持久化单元的内部支持。

items.source:
Set the PersistenceUnitPostProcessors to be applied to the
PersistenceUnitInfo used for creating this EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: 将用于创建此 EntityManagerFactory 的 PersistenceUnitInfo 所应用的 PersistenceUnitPostProcessors 设置好。

items.source:
Return the PersistenceUnitPostProcessors to be applied to each
PersistenceUnitInfo that has been parsed by this manager.
items.translation: 返回此管理器已解析的每个 `PersistenceUnitInfo` 所应用的 `PersistenceUnitPostProcessors`。

items.source:
Set the PersistenceUnitPostProcessors to be applied to each
PersistenceUnitInfo that has been parsed by this manager.
items.translation: 将已解析的每个 `PersistenceUnitInfo` 所应用的 `PersistenceUnitPostProcessors` 设置为此管理器。
